title: Maximum Non-overlapping Slots

statement.md: A matching engine has $n$ requested time slots $[s_i, e_i)$ with $s_i < e_i$. Two slots overlap if they share any time; a slot ending at time $t$ and another starting at time $t$ do **not** overlap. Choose as many slots as possible so that no two chosen slots overlap.
Print the maximum number of slots.

hints: Which slot should you take first so that the most time is left for the others?
Sort by end time and take a slot whenever it starts at or after the end of the last one taken.
editorial: [{"type": "p", "md": "Greedy by earliest end. Sort slots by end time (break ties by start). Keep the end of the last chosen slot; take the next slot if its start is at least that end. The exchange argument: among slots compatible with the choices so far, one that ends earliest leaves the largest set of options, so some optimal solution contains it. Time $O(n \\log n)$. Sorting by start time or by length is not correct."}]

solutions.python:
import sys


def main():
    tok = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(tok[0])
    iv = sorted((int(tok[2 + 2 * i]), int(tok[1 + 2 * i])) for i in range(n))  # (end, start)
    last = -1
    count = 0
    for e, s in iv:
        if s >= last:
            count += 1
            last = e
    print(count)


main()
